in_arabic.name: Bashur
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عربي يعني Servant of God
in_arabic.long_meaning: Bashur هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. From the Arabic word 'basharah', meaning 'to inform' or 'to bring glad tidings'. In Islamic context, the name Bashur signifies a servant of God, spreading the good news of His blessings and guidance.

in_urdu.name: Bashur
in_urdu.meaning: اسلامی نام جس کا مطلب ہے Servant of God
in_urdu.long_meaning: Bashur ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو مسلم ثقافت میں گہری روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ From the Arabic word 'basharah', meaning 'to inform' or 'to bring glad tidings'. In Islamic context, the name Bashur signifies a servant of God, spreading the good news of His blessings and guidance.

in_hindi.name: Bashur
in_hindi.meaning: इस्लामी नाम जिसका अर्थ है Servant of God

In Islamic context, the name Bashur signifies a servant of God, spreading the good news of His blessings and guidance.
